get.summary: List datasets (paged when both `page` and `size` are given).

post.summary:
Store a dataset: JSON `{name, data, target?}`, or a CSV or JSON `file` (with `name` and
`target`) as `multipart/form-data`. It is checked (periods in any form chap-core reads, a
location on every row, a numeric target) and stored as given.

get.summary: Get a dataset's description.

The dataset as stored, chapkit DataFrame JSON, or a projection of it: `location`
(repeatable) for some locations' rows, `column` (repeatable) for only those columns besides
`time_period` and `location`, `before` for the periods before one, `last` for the last periods,
and `canonical=true` for the periods as chapkit writes them (`2024-01`, `2024W03`, `2024SunW03`),
the rows in period order.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Only these columns besides time_period and location (repeatable)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only the periods before this one, in any form a dataset takes

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: Only the last this many periods (after `before`)

parameters.name: canonical
parameters.description: Periods as chapkit writes them, the rows in period order

get.summary: Service information (the service's `ServiceInfo` / `MLServiceInfo` JSON).
List jobs, newest first.
JSON schema of the job list.
Get a job.

delete.summary: Cancel (if running) and delete a job.

get.summary:
Stream a job's record as server-sent events until it finishes. Sends
`{"status": "deleted"}` and stops if the job is deleted.

post.summary:
Backtest the model on a dataset (`data`, or a stored `dataset_id`) in-process, scored as
chap-core scores it. Returns 202; the result (as `<bin> eval --json` prints it, with every
forecast's quantiles against the truth) is stored as an `ml_backtest` artifact.
chapkit-rs extension; not part of Python chapkit.

Explain one forecast cell with LIME or KernelSHAP, computed in-process: every
perturbation is a direct model call, run in parallel across cores when that is faster.
Features are the cell's covariates, their earlier values and the target's history.
chapkit-rs extension; not part of Python chapkit.

Forecast past the end of a dataset (`data`, or a stored `dataset_id`), as chap-core's
`forecast_ahead`: train on all of it, give the model the next `periods` periods' covariates
from the weather provider, and predict. Returns 202; the forecast (each location and period's
quantiles, and the prediction frame) is stored as an `ml_forecast` artifact.
chapkit-rs extension; not part of Python chapkit.

get.summary:
A ready-to-submit sample `$train` or `$predict` payload from the synthetic data
generator (same columns and options as Python chapkit's).

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: `monthly` or `weekly` (default: the model's period type, else monthly).

parameters.name: include_geo
parameters.description: Default: whether the model requires geo.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Negative (default) for fresh data each call.

post.summary:
Search the model's hyperparameters (random or grid over its `hpo_search_space`), each trial
an in-process backtest. Returns 202; the trials, the best config and its backtest are stored
as an `ml_hpo` artifact, and with `create_config` the best config is created.
chapkit-rs extension; not part of Python chapkit.
Predict with a trained model. Returns 202; the prediction artifact is a child of the training artifact.

Forecast every backtest split of one training in one call: each split's frame equals what
`$predict` stores for that split alone. Splits give `historic`, or `historic_end` to cut the
shared `historic`. Answers 200 with the frames when they are ready within the eager budget
(nothing stored, like `$predict-sync`), else 202 with a job whose `ml_prediction_splits`
artifact holds the list, like `$predict`.
chapkit-rs extension; not part of Python chapkit.

Predict and return the forecast directly: no job, no stored artifact. The trained
model is kept warm in memory, so repeated calls cost only the model itself.
chapkit-rs extension; not part of Python chapkit.
Train a model. Returns 202 with the job id and the artifact id the model will be stored under.
Check a train or predict request without running it.

ArtifactIn.description: An artifact to create or replace.

level.description: Ignored: the level is computed from the parent.

ArtifactTreeNode.description: An artifact in a tree view.

config_id.description: A stored config; or give `config`, or neither for the defaults.

BacktestRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$backtest`: a backtest of the model on `data` or a stored dataset.

BacktestSettings.description:
Backtest settings of `$backtest` and `$hpo`: chap-core's `BacktestParams` and its dataset
preparation, each optional.

drop_untrained.description: Leave out locations with no target before the test windows (default true).

fill_gaps.description: Fill gaps in a location's periods (default true).

pad.description: Pad locations to the full period range (default true).

periods.description: Periods per forecast (default: the config's `prediction_periods`, else 3).

ConfigIn.description: A config to create or replace.

data.description: The dataset, chapkit DataFrame JSON, with `time_period`, `location` and the target.

DatasetMeta.description: What the service computed of a dataset when it was stored.

covariates.description: Numeric columns other than the target, `time_period` and `location`.

first_period.description: First period, as chapkit writes it (`2024-01`, `2024W01`).

last_period.description: Last period, as chapkit writes it.

DatasetUpload.description: `POST /api/v1/datasets` as `multipart/form-data`: a CSV or chapkit DataFrame JSON file.

file.description: CSV, or chapkit DataFrame JSON (a `.json` name or a body starting with `{`).

ExplainRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$explain`: explain one forecast cell of a trained model.

features.description: Covariates to explain (default: every numeric covariate in `future`).

geo.description: Passed to every model call, as in `$predict`.

lags.description: Historic periods perturbed under `temporal`. Default 3, at most 52.

location.description: Location of the cell to explain.

n_samples.description: Perturbations (LIME) or sampled coalitions (SHAP above 12 features). Default 500.

scope.description:
`temporal` (default): the cell's covariates, their earlier values and the target's
history; `row`: the cell's covariates only.

time_period.description: Period of the cell to explain.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall time of the explanation, all model calls included.

ForecastRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$forecast`: train on the whole dataset and forecast the periods after it.

config_id.description: A stored config; or give `config`, or neither for the defaults.

periods.description: Periods to forecast (default: the config's `prediction_periods`, else 3).

HealthState.description: Health of one check or of the whole service.

checks.description: Per-check results; omitted when there are no checks.

config_id.description: A stored config whose options every candidate is merged into; or give `config`.

create_config.description: Store the best config as a new config (default false).

grid_points.description: Points a continuous float range is split into by `grid` with `grid_ranges` (default 5).

grid_ranges.description: Let `grid` step through ranges; chap-core's grid takes choices only (default false).

HpoRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/ml/$hpo`: a hyperparameter search over the model's search space, each trial a
backtest on `data`.

finished_at.description: When it reached a terminal state.

ListOrPage_ArtifactOut.description:
A list response: a plain array, or a [`Paginated`] page when both `page` and `size`
are given. Used for OpenAPI documentation of list endpoints.

ListOrPage_ConfigOut.description:
A list response: a plain array, or a [`Paginated`] page when both `page` and `size`
are given. Used for OpenAPI documentation of list endpoints.

ListOrPage_DatasetOut.description:
A list response: a plain array, or a [`Paginated`] page when both `page` and `size`
are given. Used for OpenAPI documentation of list endpoints.

pages.description: Number of pages (0 when there are no items).
Number of pages (0 when there are no items).
Number of pages (0 when there are no items).

PredictSplitsRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$predict-splits`: the forecasts of every backtest split of one training.

config_id.description: Checked against the training artifact's config when given.

historic.description: History shared by the splits that give `historic_end`.

PredictSplitsResponse.description: `$predict-splits` finished within the eager budget: the forecasts, not stored.

predictions.description: One prediction frame per split, in order, as `$predict` stores them.

instance.description: The request path or URL the problem occurred on.

Problem.description:
A problem+json response body. `None` fields are omitted, extensions are
flattened into the top level.

RunInfoIn.description: Runtime context chap-core attaches to train and predict requests.

SplitIn.description:
One backtest split of `$predict-splits`: its future, and its history given in full or as the
period the shared `historic` is cut at.

historic_end.description: Last period of the shared `historic` this split sees (inclusive).

SystemInfo.description: Host information, shaped like servicekit's system response.

python_version.description: Always null: this is a Rust service. Kept for shape compatibility.

ValidateRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$validate`: a train or predict body plus `type`.

geo.description: Passed to the model's own checks.
